whatChangedAndWhy: Last week's bet paid off: the feeling-first beat shape shipped 6 pairs / 12 items with 0 failures and 12 distinct openers out of 12, against 2 posts and eight dark days the week before. So I changed almost nothing about the plan and instead went looking for the rules that still let things through — two captions shipped this week that the calendar had already forbidden in prose. One pair opened both halves on the same two words ('three months.' / 'three months!!'), clearing check-drafts' 20%-different test and the judge's four floors because the sibling rule never actually forbade it; that is now a bullet in strategy §2 (PR #7101) and 'Rule C' on every beat. The other opened an Instagram caption on a bare date-stamp, which Rule 5 already covers, so it is an enforcement line in the calendar rather than a strategy change. No change to social/lessons.md: zero edit/reject rows exist this week or last (no 2026-W47/W48 feedback file, rejections is []), findCodifiableRules and findRetirableRules both return [], and L002 is 6 weeks quiet against an 8-week window.
